scope: Companion has a new AI assistant. It checks and rewrites your writing, sums up long emails and pages, and describes pictures. First letters work in the email account and folder lists. YouTube no longer freezes when you press N or End.

topics.title: AI assistant
details: Press Control+Shift+Q, or say AI assistant, to open it.
It works where you read and write. That means documents, emails, notes and web pages. It also works in Help, and on pictures.
The first time, it asks if you want to use it. Say yes or no.
Each choice is also in the Alt menu, and you can say it, too.

topics.title: Writing help
details: Say check for errors. You hear each mistake and how to fix it.
Press Enter to keep a fix, or Delete to skip it. Control+Enter keeps them all.
Say make it friendlier, more professional, clearer, or shorter.
You hear the new words first. Press Enter to use them, or Escape to keep yours.
Undo puts your own words back.

topics.title: Reading help
details: Say summarise to hear the main points of an email, page or document.
Say simplify to hear it in plain words.
Use the arrows to read the answer a line at a time.

topics.title: Pictures and questions
details: In File manager or in an email's attachments, say describe the image.
You hear what is in the picture, and any writing in it.
You can describe 200 pictures a month. Reading and writing help has no limit.
In Help, say ask a question. The answer comes from the user guide.

topics.title: First letters in email lists
details: In the list of email accounts, press a letter to jump to the account that starts with it.
In the folder list, a letter jumps to the folder. Press it again for the next one.
This works when you open the lists with Control+Y, and when you say go to folder.

topics.title: YouTube no longer freezes
details: Pressing N for the next video could freeze Companion when YouTube was slow.
Pressing End to load more videos could freeze it, too.
Now Companion waits only a few seconds. If YouTube is slow, it tells you, and you can keep working.
